parts.name: Root
parts.description: A line between two groups of content: a `role="separator"` element, or `role="none"` when decorative. With a `value`, a window splitter the keyboard and the pointer move. Give it a size with CSS.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
The direction of the line. A horizontal separator sits between two blocks, one above the
other. A vertical one sits between two items side by side, such as in a toolbar.

props.name: decorative
props.description:
Makes the separator a visual line only. A screen reader then skips it. Use it for a line
that repeats a break the content already makes, such as a border between two sections
with headings. Without it, the separator is a `role="separator"` element, which a screen
reader reads as a break between two groups of content. A separator with a `value` keeps
its role.

props.name: value
props.description:
Makes the separator a window splitter the user moves: the size of the pane before it, as a
number between `min` and `max`. Use `bind:value` and give the pane its size from it. The
splitter is a tab stop. The arrow keys move it, `Home` and `End` send it to the ends, and
`Enter` folds the pane and unfolds it. The pointer drags it along its parent.

props.name: min
props.description: The value with the pane folded.

props.name: max
props.description: The value with the pane at its largest.

props.name: step
props.description: The move of one arrow key.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: The move of one arrow key with `Shift`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the value after each move.

props.name: aria-controls
props.description: The id of the pane the splitter sizes, for `aria-controls`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Holds the splitter still. It stays a tab stop, and it says it is disabled.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: element
props.description: The separator element. Use `bind:element` to read it.

dataAttributes.name: data-decorative
dataAttributes.description: Present when the separator is decorative.

dataAttributes.name: data-dragging
dataAttributes.description: Present while the pointer drags the splitter.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the splitter has the focus from the keyboard.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the splitter has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-movable
dataAttributes.description: Present on a window splitter: a separator with a `value`.
